description: Run an asset selection at a fixed interval (every N minutes / hours / days / weeks / months). Supports time-based partitioned assets via build_schedule_from_partitioned_job — set partition_type + partition_start and the interval must match the partition cadence (every: 1h ↔ hourly, every: 1d ↔ daily, etc.). Mirrors cron_schedule's partition surface.

every.label: Every
every.description: Interval value + unit: e.g. '15m', '2h', '1d', '1w', '1mo'. In partitioned mode, must be exactly '1<unit>' where unit matches the partition cadence.

asset_keys.label: Asset Keys
asset_keys.description: Slash-separated asset keys to materialize on each tick.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the underlying job (defaults to '<schedule_name>_job').

execution_timezone.label: Execution Timezone
execution_timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Applied only in the un-partitioned path — in the partitioned path Dagster uses the partitions_def's timezone.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags applied to runs created by this schedule.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned. Only time-based types work with the partitioned-job path.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start in ISO format (e.g. '2024-01-01' or '2024-01-01-00:00' for hourly). Required for time-based types.

dynamic_partition_name.label: Dynamic Partition Name
dynamic_partition_name.description: Name for DynamicPartitionsDefinition (rejected by this schedule — declared for parity with cron_schedule).

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: IntervalSchedule
